text: The Pentagon dismissed reports of “kamikaze dolphins” in the Strait of Hormuz, with Gen. Dan Caine joking, “Like sharks with laser beams.” Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth added he could not confirm such claims, but said he "can't confirm or deny whether we have kamikaze dolphins"
translated_text: 五角大楼驳回了有关霍尔木兹海峡出现“神风特攻队海豚”的报道，丹·凯恩将军开玩笑说，“就像带有激光束的鲨鱼”。国防部长皮特·赫格斯补充说，他无法证实此类说法，但表示他“无法证实或否认我们是否有神风海豚”

text: The Supreme Court on Monday allowed last week's landmark decision striking down Louisiana's congressional map to take effect immediately, drawing a sharp back-and-forth between two justices.
translated_text: 最高法院周一允许上周推翻路易斯安那州国会地图的里程碑式裁决立即生效，引发了两位法官之间的激烈争执。

text: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth warned Iran against targeting U.S. forces or commercial vessels, saying any attack would be met with “overwhelming and devastating American firepower" while urging Tehran to allow ships to pass freely through the Strait of Hormuz.
translated_text: 国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯警告伊朗不要针对美军或商船，称任何袭击都将遭到“美国压倒性和毁灭性的火力”，同时敦促德黑兰允许船只自由通过霍尔木兹海峡。
